facts.text: The image is a composite character reference sheet: a large environmental hero panel at top, a middle row of three full-body turnaround views, and a bottom row of four detail close-ups.
The central subject is an adult person with short dark hair that is shaved at the sides and gathered into a small topknot at the back.
The person wears an all-black tactical outfit: a high-collared jacket with straps and metal buckle details, a dark shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
A metallic tag necklace is visible at the neck in the full-body views.
In the top hero panel, the person stands full-body on a wet paved walkway at night, with metal railings, blurred city lights, and visible rain.
The middle row shows the same person standing in three full-body views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK.
In the FRONT panel, the person faces forward with arms relaxed at the sides and a neutral, serious expression.
In the SIDE PROFILE panel, the person faces left in a standing profile pose.
In the BACK panel, the person is seen from behind, showing the jacket back and the small topknot.
The FACE close-up shows a head-and-shoulders view with a neutral, serious expression and a thin scar-like mark through one eyebrow.
The JACKET COLLAR close-up shows dark textured fabric, a zipper, and a strap with a metal buckle.
The HANDS close-up shows two hands with visible veins and skin texture, held close together.
The BOOTS close-up shows black lace-up combat boots with worn, scuffed leather.
Visible labels printed on the sheet read HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
The lower reference panels are set against a dark, neutral studio-like background and are separated by black gutters.
The lighting is low-key and cinematic, with cool blue-gray tones and amber background highlights in the hero panel.

card.summary: A cinematic character reference sheet for a person in an all-black tactical outfit, featuring a rainy environmental hero shot, studio turnaround views, and close-up detail panels.
